caption: Armenia ❤️ Namibia: atelier handclasps, couch embraces and coastal-window closeness. Four fictional adult friends in sculpted minis and varied heels. AI fashion; distant smoke and mushroom-shaped clouds are imaginary, not real events.
orderedVisualQa: Main reviewed all four ALT editor images and final row-major grid. Upload order matches scenes 2067,2068,2071,2072.

altChecks.alt: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a warm pink-stone window atelier. A braided Black woman sits left while a blonde woman hugs her from behind; two dark-haired women lean in around a handclasp. Garnet, ivory, red-blue-orange and navy mini dresses are paired with varied heels, rainbow footwear and visible arm tattoos. The opaque mini dresses have a closer, shorter tailored fit.

AI-generated portrait of four fictional adult women gathered closely on an apricot couch beside tall city-facing windows. The braided woman reclines against cushions while the blonde and two dark-haired women lean toward her, exchanging a shoulder touch and hand contact. Charcoal, apricot, pearl and plum garments, rainbow hosiery and RAZE, GRD and scorpion arm motifs are visible.

AI-generated fictional Namibia fashion editorial: four adult women share a handclasp and shoulder touch around cobalt seating in a windowed atelier. A flag-inspired mini, ivory dress, cobalt top with sand skort, and emerald dress pair with varied heels and rainbow legwear. A crescent arm tattoo is visible. Distant smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary, not a real event.

AI-generated fictional Namibia fashion editorial: four adult women smile in a close diagonal embrace beside a coastal window. Coral and slate-blue tailoring, a pearl one-shoulder dress, a white mini skort and a blue flag-inspired bodice frame the group. Split-star and crescent arm tattoos are visible.
